reason: A scientific research workbench centered on ReAct research workflows, experiment and artifact provenance, bioinformatics skills, and optional SSH/HPC remote computation; human review is warranted because it can execute jobs on external hosts and modify project files.

summaries.zh: 面向基因组学、病原体和生物信息学项目的科研工作台，提供研究循环、实验与成果溯源管理，以及经审批的 SSH/HPC 远程计算。
summaries.en: A scientific research workbench for genomics, pathogen, and bioinformatics projects that provides research loops, provenance-aware artifact management, and approval-gated SSH/HPC remote computation.

capabilities: Manages a persistent research workflow and experiment state
Creates, versions, verifies, compares, and deprecates artifacts with provenance metadata
Reads and writes project files and structured research records
Connects to configured SSH hosts and HPC clusters
Submits, monitors, cancels, and retrieves remote jobs
Routes selected auxiliary and subagent model requests across configured providers
